model_output.rationale: All four lines carry CO-16; MOA N286 at claim level identifies the defect: missing/incomplete/invalid referring provider primary identifier. The 837P lists billing and rendering providers but no referring/ordering provider loop. Medicare Part B data defect → correct and resubmit as a new original claim (CLM05-3=1); frequency 7 is not accepted on Part B. Eligibility is active; therapy modifiers GP+KX are present; no other defect identified.

root_cause.explanation: 837P contains no referring provider loop. MOA N286 on the 835 confirms missing/invalid referring provider NPI. All four lines denied CO-16 as a result.

next_action.detail: Verify ordering/referring provider name and NPI in PECOS. Add the referring provider loop to the 837P. Submit as a new original claim (CLM05-3=1, no REF*F8). Do not use frequency 7 — Medicare Part B rejects it.

evidence.fact: MOA N286 at claim level: missing/incomplete/invalid referring provider primary identifier.
All four lines: CO-16 (claim/service lacks information or has submission/billing error), $310.83 withheld.
Parties list billing provider and rendering provider (Mary Clark NPI 1992501921) but no referring/ordering provider loop.
Medicare Part B: CO-16+N286 → correct_and_resubmit as new original CLM05-3=1; frequency 7 not accepted on Part B.

citations.rule: CO-16+N286 = data defect; correct and resubmit; do not appeal; Medicare Part B CLM05-3=1 only
Frequency 7 not accepted on Medicare Part B 837P; new original CLM05-3=1
